title: One-Way Streets
statement: A town has n squares, 0 to n − 1, joined by one-way streets streets[i] = [a, b] from a to b. Return true if you can drive from square start to square end.

answerKey.pattern: BFS or DFS following edge direction
keyPoints: Build an adjacency list of outgoing streets only
Search from start with a visited set
Return true if end is reached
edgeCases: Streets only in the wrong direction
acceptableSlowerApproaches: Repeatedly expand the reached set until it stops growing: O(V · E)

hints: Which way can you use a one-way street?
Only from a to b: store outgoing streets only.
Run BFS or DFS from start and see whether end is visited.
